disabled.title: Demo feature is disabled
disabled.body: These actions require the server to have ENABLE_DEMO_RESET=true. In a real deployment this should stay disabled.

bannerWarning: These actions affect ALL clinic data and are meant for demos or local testing — not everyday use.
genericError: Something went wrong, please try again

wipe.title: Reset Clinic to First-Login State
wipe.description: Permanently deletes every patient, appointment, treatment, invoice, document, and inventory item, and resets the dashboard's appearance (colors, fonts, logo) back to defaults — exactly as it would look the very first time the dashboard is opened after logging in. You'll be logged out automatically afterward, so your next login actually shows the first-time setup.
wipe.preserves: Your account is PRESERVED — you'll be logged out, but can log straight back in with the same password.
wipe.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Every patient, appointment, treatment, and invoice will be permanently deleted, and you'll be logged out automatically.

restore.title: Generate Sample Data
restore.description: Immediately generates sample patients, appointments, treatments, invoices, and inventory items — linked to your current doctors — for demos or testing.
restore.confirmBody: This adds sample patients, appointments, treatments, invoices, and inventory items on top of existing data. It doesn't delete anything.
restore.summary: Last run: {patients} patients, {appointments} appointments, {treatments} treatments, {invoices} invoices, {items} inventory items
